title: Magic Card size caps
description: Shape of tools/size-caps.json, the one source of every dist size cap. Read by tools/check-dist-size.mjs. magic-card.js is gated on gzip bytes through a stage ladder and on the byte length of its shipped .br sibling; every other file on raw bytes under a ceiling. A raised cap or ceiling needs an approved_raises entry with the same field, from and to.

gzip.description: How gzip bytes are measured. zlib.gzipSync(buffer, { level }) on the pinned Node. CI fails when process.versions.zlib differs from `zlib` or process.versions.brotli differs from `brotli`; a local run with another version prints the result as not authoritative.

node.description: Exact Node version, equal to .nvmrc and the CI setup-node version, e.g. 24.11.1

brotli.description: process.versions.brotli of that Node (the .br siblings are built with it)

final_cap.description: 60 KiB. The checker also holds this number as a constant, so editing the JSON cannot move it.

current_stage.description: The stage whose cap is active. Moved forward only, by the stage-close commit.

cap.description: gzip bytes. null until the stage closes; then the measured gzip of the landing commit (no margin). Each cap <= the previous stage's cap; the last stage's cap <= final_cap.

measured.description: gzip at landed_commit, kept for the record.

trace_ms.description: Warn-only time to first card, median of 3: { plain, effect }.

br.description: Gate on dist/magic-card.js.br, the bytes HA sends to a browser that accepts br. The checker fails when the file is missing, does not decompress to dist/magic-card.js byte for byte, is larger than `cap` (when not null), or is larger than the active stage's gzip cap.

quality.description: BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY used by tools/compress-dist.mjs (lgwin 22, mode text, size hint = input length).

cap.description: Bytes of the .br file. null until the first stage closes; each stage close sets it to the measured size at the landing commit (it only goes down). A raise needs an approved_raises entry with field /entry/br/cap.

measured.description: .br bytes at the last stage close, kept for the record.

files.description: Every other dist .js file by logical name (the content hash stripped: magic-card-<name>.<hash8>.js -> magic-card-<name>.js). A dist file with no entry fails. An entry with no file fails unless `optional` is true. The .js.br and .js.gz siblings are not listed: the checker requires both next to every .js, requires each to decompress to that .js byte for byte, and fails on a sibling whose .js is missing.

raw.description: Cap: measured + 5 %, rounded up to 1 KiB, never above `ceiling`.

ceiling.description: Upper bound for the raw cap. A measured size above it means code was copied in. Raising it needs an approved_raises entry.

note.description: What is in the file and how its cap is derived.

approved_raises.description: Append-only. CI compares tools/size-caps.json with the base branch: every entry cap, stage cap, /entry/br/cap, file ceiling or raw cap above a new file's ceiling that went up must have an entry here with matching field, from and to. Entries already in the base file stay in place.

id.description: Unique. Names the field and the new value, e.g. entry-br-cap-106394.

field.description: JSON pointer of the raised value, e.g. /entry/stages/1/cap, /entry/br/cap or /files/magic-card-flows.js/ceiling
